newsitem.title: USA: Motorola in Bogota cable modem deal.
newsitem.headline: Motorola in Bogota cable modem deal.

text.p: Motorola Inc's Multimedia Group said Monday it signed a contract with TV Cable Bogota in Colombia for commercial deployment of its CyberSURFR cable modems.
The contract calls for the delivery of the cable modems throughout 1997. The company said it is the first commercial cable modem deployment in South America for Motorola.

TV Cable Bogota passes 150,000 homes in the Bogota area and is one of the largest cable companies in South America. The company is planning to deploy cable telephony in late fourth quarter this year, Motorola said.

The CyberSURFR modem connects subscriber personal computers for on-line services, Internet access, telecommuting and other services. The modem offers speeds of up to 10 Megabits per second in the downstream path and upstream of up to 768 Kilobits per second.
